title: Samsung RS28 — LED test mode entry
description: Enter test mode for manual operation and forced defrost (§4-2-8).

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press Fridge + Power Cool simultaneously 6 s — display blinks 0.5 s. Release and press Power Cool to enter test mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Fridge + Power Cool simultaneously 6 s — display blinks 0.5 s. Release and press Power Cool to enter test mode.

steps.title: Test mode sequence
steps.body: Within 15 s press any key: FF (manual op) → Fd (forced F defrost) → cancel (display off). Power cycle cancels.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 15 s press any key: FF (manual op) → Fd (forced F defrost) → cancel (display off). Power cycle cancels.
